newsitem.title: FRANCE: France declines comment on size of F.Telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: France declines comment on size of F.Telecom stake.

text.p: The French finance ministry declined comment on Wednesday on the size of the stake it plans to sell in telecommunications operator France Telecom.
France Telecom head Michel Bon said earlier the government would sell between 30 billion and 50 billion francs' worth of shares in the company in May.
The government had originally said it expected to raise at least 25 billion francs from the sale.
A finance ministry official declined to give the likely size of the stake in France Telecom implied by the figures, which would be the equivalent of setting a value for France Telecom.

"The ministry is not announcing a value for France Telecom," he said. He added that the final amount sold would be determined by demand and market conditions but noted that in any case it would be less than 50 percent of the company.
Earlier this month financial daily Les Echos said the government was considering selling 25-35 percent of France Telecom, which it estimated would raise 35-45 billion francs.
